description: Check a single candidate startup or product name across top TLDs (.com, .io, .ai, .dev via live RDAP/DNS), public developer handles (GitHub, npm, PyPI, Bluesky), and live USPTO trademark records, returning a 0-100 Brand Readiness Score. Use this tool when evaluating candidate names before registering a domain; use `full_launch_readiness_audit` instead when auditing an already-chosen domain across brand, email DNS, and AI search visibility together.

name.description: Candidate brand or product name to screen (alphanumeric label, e.g. 'linear' or 'resend').

tlds.description: Optional list of domain extensions without leading dots (defaults to ['com', 'io', 'ai', 'dev'], max 6).

name: check_brand_availability

checkedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the live check.

grade.description: Letter grade from A to D.

trademarks.description: Matched live USPTO trademark filings, if any.

upgradeLinks.description: Links for batch CSV screening and Nice Class clearance.

title: Brand, Domain & USPTO Trademark Availability Check
